sensor.units: m, s, rad; bias rad/s; gyro N rad/sqrt(s); bias RW rad/s/sqrt(s)

config.synthetic_observation: range sigma .05m + analytic ratio .6cos(phi_rx) sigma .09; no RF H/LUT used
config.synthetic_range_filter_R: legacy .05^2 + tap quantization variance + extra .05^2 preserved, intentionally exceeds synthetic generator
config.truth_field_policy: evaluation_* only; generator/controlled initialization and evaluation use truth; EKF receives measurements only
config.covariance_policy: full covariance only for online EKF; deterministic/fixed baselines do not claim a prior
